citations.quote: Concussive Blows won't be applied if the attack is dodged or blocked or if the attack misses.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Dodged, blocked or missed attacks do not apply stacks.

citations.quote: Braum's basic attacks and Winter's Bite each apply a stack of Concussive Blows to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Stacks last 4 seconds and subsequent applications refresh their duration.

citations.quote: Braum's basic attacks apply Concussive Blows. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows.
Once the first stack has been applied, any allied champion's basic attack applies an additional stack to the target on-hit.

core_mechanics.summary: Braum's basic attacks apply stacks; allied champions' basic attacks add stacks after the first is applied.

citations.quote: Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes magic damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Reaching four stacks stuns the target and deals magic damage.

citations.quote: For the next few seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus magic damage from Braum's basic attacks.

core_mechanics.summary: After triggering, the target temporarily cannot receive new stacks, while Braum's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to it.

unsupported_claims: Allied abilities generally add Concussive Blows stacks.
Allied basic attacks receive Braum's bonus magic damage against temporarily stack-immune targets.

citations.quote: This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The projectile originates from Braum's position at the end of the cast time.

citations.quote: slowing them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The slow decays over its duration.

citations.quote: Braum propels ice from his shield in the target direction, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds.
Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, slowing and dealing magic damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Fires ice in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage to and slowing the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.
Braum's basic attacks and Winter's Bite apply a stack of Concussive Blows.

core_mechanics.summary: Applies one Concussive Blows stack to its target.

unsupported_claims: The projectile pierces enemies and applies its effects to every enemy along its path.

citations.quote: Stand Behind Me can be self cast to instantly grant Braum the bonus resistances.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Self-casting instantly grants Braum the resistances.

citations.quote: Stand Behind Me can be used on allied minions but not on wards nor traps.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Wards and traps are not eligible targets.

citations.quote: Braum dashes to put himself between the target ally and the closest visible enemy champion within 1500 units
If there are no nearby enemy champions, Braum will dash to land up-to 150 units on the far side of his target.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Landing position depends on nearby visible enemy champions; without nearby enemy champions, Braum lands on the far side of the ally.

citations.quote: If the dash is interrupted, neither Braum nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.

advanced_exceptions.summary: An interrupted dash grants neither participant the resistances.

citations.quote: Unbreakable can be cast during the dash.
If Unbreakable is cast during the dash, Winter's Bite and Glacial Fissure may also be cast.

advanced_exceptions.summary: E can be cast during the dash; casting E during it also permits Q and R to be cast.

citations.quote: Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion.
Braum dashes to a target allied champion or minion.

core_mechanics.summary: Dashes to a targeted allied champion or minion.

citations.quote: On arrival, Braum and the ally gain Armor and Magic Resist for a few seconds.
On arrival, both of them gain armor and magic resistance for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: On arrival, temporarily grants armor and magic resistance to Braum and the targeted ally.

unsupported_claims: The dash cleanses crowd control from the targeted ally.

citations.quote: Unbreakable does not affect turrets.
Incoming: Damage sources coming from somewhere facing the shield. Those coming from different sides are not affected.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Protection is directional and does not affect turrets.

citations.quote: The first instance of damage dealt by a champion from this direction is reduced by 100%.
Unbreakable's full damage reduction can block multiple instances of damage if they're dealt at the same time.
Damage over time is calculated per tick but the full damage reduction will still only apply to a single tick.
The one-time-use full damage reduction will not be consumed if the damage source is nothing but true damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The detailed first-hit rule specifies champion damage. Simultaneous instances can share full reduction; damage over time normally uses it on a single tick. Pure true damage does not consume it, which does not establish that true damage is negated.

citations.quote: The damage reduction will affect any source of damage whose origin is in front of the shield.
Melee and non-projectile-based ranged attacks.
Instantaneously-placed ground-targeted abilities (e.g. Lay Waste, Pillar of Flame, Rupture) relative to the ability's center and not the caster's.
The damage reduction only benefits Braum.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Damage reduction extends beyond projectiles, including melee attacks and eligible abilities. Ground-targeted abilities use their center to determine direction. The reduction itself benefits only Braum.

citations.quote: Projectiles whose effects trigger on collision will still trigger - dealing damage, applying debuffs, creating area of effects and marking the target as 'hit'.
Projectiles that create an area of effect upon their collision will still affect other units and not only Braum.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Interception does not cancel collision effects, debuffs or resulting areas of effect; those areas can still affect other units.

citations.quote: Moving units do not count for being blocked by Unbreakable.
Champion summoned units are not classified as units until they hit the ground (e.g. Sapling Toss) and thus will interact with Unbreakable whilst en route.
Projectiles that cannot hit Braum or his allies (such as an enemy Prismatic Barrier) will not be intercepted.[2]
Soraka's Starcall's Rejuvenation projectile is however blocked.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Moving units are not blocked. Airborne summoned units can interact before landing. Projectiles unable to hit Braum or allies generally are not intercepted, with a named Rejuvenation exception.

citations.quote: While his shield is raised, Braum also gains 10% bonus movement speed and ghosting.

advanced_exceptions.summary: While shielding, Braum gains movement speed and ghosting.

citations.quote: If Braum is protected by a spell shield, both it and the one-time-use full damage reduction can be consumed by a single blockable spell.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A single blockable spell can consume both a spell shield and E's one-time full reduction.

citations.quote: Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed.
creating a barrier in front of him that intercepts all incoming hostile projectiles

core_mechanics.summary: Raises a directional shield that intercepts eligible incoming hostile projectiles, making them hit Braum and be destroyed.

citations.quote: He negates the damage of the first attack completely
The first instance of damage dealt by a champion from this direction is reduced by 100%.

core_mechanics.summary: Fully negates the first eligible instance of champion damage from the shielded direction.

citations.quote: reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.
reduces the damage Braum takes through it from enemies in the target direction.

core_mechanics.summary: Reduces subsequent eligible damage Braum takes from the shielded direction while active.

unsupported_claims: Braum or allies become immune to all damage and crowd control while E is active.
E directly grants its damage reduction to allies behind Braum.
Every projectile is intercepted regardless of eligibility.
The first-hit negation necessarily blocks true damage.
Destroying a projectile prevents all of its collision effects.

citations.quote: The first target hit is knocked up for at least 0.6 seconds, increased if they are further away from Braum. All other enemies hit are knocked up for 0.6 seconds.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The first target's knockup duration increases with distance; other enemies receive the shorter fixed knockup.

citations.quote: This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The ability originates from Braum's position at the end of the cast time.

citations.quote: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him.
Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him.

core_mechanics.summary: Knocks up enemies around Braum and along a line in front of him.

citations.quote: creating a fissure from the impact that travels forth in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies within its path as well as those around Braum.

core_mechanics.summary: Deals magic damage around Braum and along the fissure's path.

citations.quote: A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.
A field of ice is created along the fissure's path, lasting for 4 seconds and slowing enemies within the area every 0.25 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Leaves a lingering ice field along the fissure that slows enemies within it.

unsupported_claims: Every enemy hit receives the first target's longer knockup.
The lingering field repeatedly knocks enemies up.
